veranderings.blok: Agt planete, en die Aarde is een
veranderings.na: in volgorde van die son af
veranderings.rede: 'van die son af' is the more natural everyday Afrikaans form for a Grade 4 reader than the formal 'vanaf'.

veranderings.blok: Wat lewende dinge by die son kry
veranderings.rede: 'leef' is the usual verb form; 'lewe' as a verb is formal and also reads like the noun used two sentences later.
